title: fix(metadata)!: the metadata service's own reads keep every locale of a package's email template and every package's item of a by-package type
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg38xLzmffQZvAGqE2vPd7Ta)_
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：metadata 服务的内存注册表和制品门的 MemoryLoader 给邮件模板的每种语言各留一个键；它们的无包复数读（loadMany / loadManyKeyed）对按包存放的类型按（包, 名）各答一项，不再把两个包的同名项折成最后写的那个。
- 为什么改：同包两种语言只剩最后一种；两个包的同名 action 只剩一个，只读 metadata 服务的宿主因此看不出两个持有者。
- 风险与回滚：标准栈对外读法（GET /meta、执行读、?package=、按名读，含两包同名 flow 与 ObjectQL 注册表）逐字节一致，含顺序；收紧只在 protocol 没有合并列表的宿主上：两个包的同名 action，激活门由 200 写一行变为 409 / 404 不写行，裸执行门由 200 运行变为 409 不运行，与标准栈答案一致。不改表、不改存储行，回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`（`memberKeyOf`、`pluralEntryKeys`、`readStoreEntry`），再看 `metadata-manager.ts` 的 `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyedSlotted` / `listedInSlotOrder`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/metadata-manager-email-template-slot.test.ts src/metadata-manager-keyed-plural-read.test.ts`，预期全部通过（新增钉子在 `[#32517]` 的 describe 里）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32517

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — on a host whose `protocol` serves no merged action listing, the action activation door and the bare execution door now refuse a call of two packages' same-named action that they served before (activation: FROM `200` and one row TO `409` / `404` and no row; execution: FROM `200` and a run TO `409`, nothing run), and MCP `list_actions` lists one row per package where it listed one for the name. Every served read of a standard stack answers the same bytes in the same order (md5 CONTROL below), and its action doors answer as before.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n "loadMany\|MemoryLoader\|_activation" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'` names no one-item-per-name rule for these reads; `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx` (`loadManyKeyed`, the database loader's stamping) and `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` (the action switch) stay true.

Claim 6817506219 by `domain:server#2`; dispatched by the epic seat (#31527, ADR-0150). Location 2 added by card comment 6818307202; file surface extended to one runtime test file by card comment 6818548633.

## What changes

`@objectstack/metadata` only (source); one runtime test file.

**Location 1: a bundled type's members.** A bundled type declares a discriminator (`ITEM_KEY_DISCRIMINATORS`): on this tree only `email_template` (`locale`, canonical `en-US`). The registry and the door's `MemoryLoader` kept one item per `(package, name)`, so a package's second locale overwrote the first.

- `memberKeyOf` keys a non-canonical member under its slot (slot key, a separator, the member). The canonical member keeps the slot's own key, so a one-locale template and every unbundled type keep exactly the keys they had. `slotOfKey` / `memberSuffixOf` read a key back; `keyIdentityOf` and `storedNameOf` strip the member.
- `storeSlotKey` / `storeWriteKey` return the member's key; a package's first item takes over the package-less slot's SAME member only. `storeRowWriteKey` (`DatabaseLoader`, already one row per member) is unchanged.
- Slot rules count slots, never members: `packageSlotsOf` lists a package once, `refuseSeveralSlots` counts distinct slots, `readStoreEntry` answers the slot's member written last (what the slot held before). `storeRemovalKeys` is main's (#32352).
- `admitLoaderSlots` shadows a loader's member by the same member only; `unregisterPackage` removes a slot's members together (one `deleted` announcement per slot, as before).
- Order: `list` (`listedInSlotOrder`) and the `MemoryLoader`'s `loadManySlots` put each slot's last-written member first, then the others, so the order the served list derives from is main's.

**Location 2: a by-package type's packages.** For `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action`, `permission`, `flow` (by-package since #32507), `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset` (since #31700 and its family), `MetadataManager.loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` and the `MemoryLoader`'s unscoped `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` folded two packages' items of one name into the one saved last.

- `pluralEntryKeys` gives each entry its `(package, name)` key, folding a package-less entry under a name exactly one package holds into that holder (D4), so a one-holder name answers exactly as before. `loadMany` and the new `loadManyKeyedSlotted` dedupe by it, first loader wins.
- The fold rule for actions after #32651: `DatabaseLoader` keeps a row per binding of one package's action name, but its own unscoped `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` still answer one per name, and main's `MemoryLoader` and manager answered one package's name once (the binding saved last). So one package's action bound to several objects stays ONE entry of these reads, the binding saved last, on the door, the database and the service alike; `list` (through `loadManySlots`) serves every binding. Pinned beside the `[#32540]` describe (main the same). Keying actions by `(package, object, name)` here would widen these reads past what main and `DatabaseLoader` answer; not done.
- The `MemoryLoader`'s `latestByName` keeps one entry per `(package, name)` for unbundled slotted types (bundled types unchanged); a package-less slot under a name one package holds folds into that holder (D4), whatever object an action binds, so a one-holder name answers its one item saved last, as main does.
- A read the registry cannot answer (`loadSlottedDiagnosed`) judges a view with no write order of its own: each slot's member written last goes first in it (`latestMembersFirst`, the `MemoryLoader`'s `loadSlots` alike) and the view answers a slot's first member (`latestMemberOf`), so a template saved `en-US`, `fr-FR`, `en-US` again answers the rewritten `en-US`, as main does, on a `MemoryLoader` and over `DatabaseLoader` rows.
- `DatabaseLoader`'s plural reads are unchanged (see the residue under Acceptance notes).
- After #32569: `environmentStoreKey` (the registry key an environment-addressed rollback writes) is `memberKeyOf(type, slotIdentityOf(type, name, data), data)`, so a non-canonical locale restored to the environment lands in its own key, never the canonical member's; `writeRegistryEntry`'s fourth argument is that key and nothing else. Pinned in `metadata-history.test.ts` (red on main's sources and with the member dropped, green here).

### Who calls `loadMany` for a slotted type, and whether the answer changes

| Caller | Answer |
| :--- | :--- |
| metadata `plugin.ts` `_loadFromFileSystem` | unchanged (file loaders hold no two packages of one name) |
| objectql `resyncAuthoredActionsNow` | unchanged (artifact-shipped items are filtered out before it acts) |
| objectql `loadMetadataFromService` at start (object/view/app/flow/hook) | `flow` is a by-package type since #32507: both packages' flow of one name reach `registerItem` (main: the one saved last). Measured on the composed stack, two packages' same-named flow and the one-holder CONTROL, `env_local` and no env: the registry's listing (all, per package) and every served flow read are byte-identical to main; only `loadMany('flow')` itself changes (FROM `[beta]` TO `[alpha, beta]`). The other four types are not by-package: unchanged. `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset` have no `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` caller (`git grep`): only the service's own read changes |
| runtime `collectHandlerOwnerCandidates` (run door `requiredPermissions` owner rows) and the REST / MCP bare-holder rule | unchanged on a standard stack (they read the protocol's merged listing); on a host without one, more rows: one per package, so each package's gate is asked |
| runtime `refuseAmbiguousActionActivation` and `bareRouteHolderRefusal` (the activation door, the bare execution door, the MCP collector) | **changed on a host without a merged listing**, FROM → TO below |

## BREAKING (narrowing), measured

Activation door `POST /actions/_activation/:object/:action`, `{ enabled: false }`, two packages each shipping `shared_ping`:

| Host | Shape | main (`874166b60` metadata built) | head |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| metadata service only (no merged listing) | bound to two objects | `200`, one row (`package_id` = the package saved last) | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both objects, no row |
| metadata service only | both object-less | `200`, one row | `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, no row |
| metadata service only | CONTROL: one package, one object | `200`, its row | `200`, its row |
| metadata service only | bare execution `POST /actions/global/shared_ping`, both object-less | `200`, the one saved last ran | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both packages, nothing ran |
| metadata service only | MCP `list_actions` (read from the code, not measured) | one row for the name | one row per package |
| composed artifact (`MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AppPlugin`), `env_local` and no env | bound pair / object-less pair / one-holder | `409` / `404` / as before | identical (diffed, 8 / 8) |

Pinned in `packages/runtime/src/domains/action-activation-unpackaged.test.ts` (real `MetadataManager` over the real `MemoryLoader`): the three NARROWING cases are red on main's metadata build (3 failed / 11 passed) and green on head (14 / 14).

## Tests

- `metadata-manager-email-template-slot.test.ts`: `[#32517] a bundled type keeps one item per (package, name, member) in the registry and the MemoryLoader` (12 cases): both locales for one holder and two holders on `list` / `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed`, the door's shape, get and remove, D3 refusal unchanged, D4 unchanged, one member's rewrite, the list order pin (one holder `[fr-FR, en-US]` as main; two holders per slot), CONTROL unbundled one item per slot.
- `metadata-manager-keyed-plural-read.test.ts`: `[#32517] the unscoped plural reads answer every package's item of an unbundled by-package type`: each of the nine by-package types in both registration orders, CONTROL one holder with a package-less item (D4), CONTROL one package's action on two objects, CONTROL a non-slotted type.
- `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: the #32246 pin's door peer now answers both packages; its database peer still answers one row per name. New: a read the registry cannot answer over the database's rows of one package's `en-US`, `fr-FR`, `en-US` again answers the rewritten `en-US` (main the same).
- `metadata-manager-email-template-slot.test.ts`, new: the same read on a loader-only manager (`MemoryLoader`), and `list()[0]` agrees with it; CONTROL the registry.
- `metadata-manager-keyed-plural-read.test.ts`, new: a package-less action and one package's of one name on two objects, both save orders: one item, the one saved last (main the same). The iterated by-package set is the live one: nine types.
- `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`, new beside `[#32540]`: one package's two bindings are one entry of the unscoped plural reads (door, database, service), `list` serves both (main the same).
- `metadata-history.test.ts`, new: an environment rollback of a `fr-FR` member files `x\u0002fr-FR`, the canonical key stays empty.
- `action-activation-unpackaged.test.ts`, new: the bare execution door on a metadata-service-only host (above).

## Verification

<details><summary>Red first, ablation, green</summary>

- Red on main (pins only): location 1, 9 failed; with location 2 and the order pins, 25 failed; every CONTROL green. The review's three pins (M2 on `MemoryLoader` and `DatabaseLoader`, S2 both orders) pass on main's sources and failed on `cf96064ea` (M2: `fr-FR` answered; S2: both items answered).
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `memberKeyOf`'s member branch replaced by `return slot;` → 9 failed, restored (blob `2af154df097a`); `pluralEntryKeys` dropping the package from the key → 10 failed, restored (blob `eb9baf7a54e9`). `git diff HEAD` empty after each. The pins import `src/`, no `dist/` in the path. Review fixes, once each: `latestMemberOf` answering `writtenLast` on a view → 3 failed; the D4 fold in `latestByName` removed → 2 failed; both restored, blobs equal to HEAD.
- Green at head `3ca888144` (main `cac0f1aab` merged): `@objectstack/metadata` 74 files / 1919 tests; `action-activation-unpackaged.test.ts` 14 / 14; metadata and runtime typecheck exit 0; `pnpm build` exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Served surfaces: md5 CONTROL, main vs head</summary>

Probe (kept with the card's project files, not committed): `createStandaloneStack`, `:memory:` DB, one-holder and two-holder artifacts shipping `pz_mail` in `en-US` and `fr-FR` and an action `pz_act`, read after boot and after a hot reload: `getMetaItems`, `getMetaItemsForExecution`, `getMetaItem` for `email_template` and `action`, with no package and with each `packageId`. Rerun at `d9e9676c8` against main `9cd5fc161` (its metadata sources built), with a third probe: the composed artifact (`MetadataPlugin` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `AppPlugin`) shipping `qa_shared_flow` in two packages, and the one-holder CONTROL, in `env_local` and with no env; read `getMetaItems` / `getMetaItemsForExecution` / `getMetaItem` for `flow` with no package and each package, and the ObjectQL registry's `listItems('flow')` (all and per package).

- Every served read identical, main vs head: the email template and action probe (both shapes, compared as sent and as sets), the composed activation probe (both topologies, 4 flips each), and the flow probe (4 runs, 15 reads each including the registry).
- Internal reads, head: `email_template` `list` / `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` answer every locale of every package (main: the last-written locale per package); `loadMany('action')` answers `[alpha, beta]` (main: `[beta]`). `loadMany('flow')` with two packages' `qa_shared_flow`: FROM `[beta]` TO `[alpha, beta]`; one holder: unchanged.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood</summary>

At `3ca888144`: running under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` when this body was written; the result is reported on the PR when it finishes. The previous head `d9e9676c8` (main `9cd5fc161`): VERDICT `command-exit 0`; Test Files 454 passed, 3 skipped (457); Tests 3809 passed, 42 skipped (3851).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

At `3ca888144`: the derived list runs after the dogfood run; reported on the PR when it finishes. At `d9e9676c8`: 65 derived, 65 run, every one exit 0; `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; `pnpm lint` exit 0.

</details>

## Overlap with open PRs

- #32551 (#32365), #32507, #32569 (#32351) and #32651 (#32540) merged into main before this head. #32551 conflicted in `readStoreEntry`: `found` maps through `latestMemberOf` first, then #32365's package-less-first and own-package-first picks over those keys. #32569 conflicted beside `keyIdentityOf`: both kept, `environmentStoreKey` keyed by member (above). #32507 and the picklist family made `flow`, `picklist`, `mapping`, `dataset` by-package types: location 2 covers them. #32651's per-binding rows: the fold rule above.

## Acceptance notes

- Residue, not touched here: `DatabaseLoader`'s `unscopedTypeRows` keeps one row per name for an unbundled slotted type, so its `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` still fold two packages. Repro: the database peer of `metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`'s #32246 pin answers one row. The seat files the card.
- Out of scope: the activation door turns `declaration.refusal` (two holders of an object-less name) into `404 has no declaration`, on main's composed stack too, where a `409` naming the holders is the answer the bare execution door gives. The seat files the card.
